Ingest</b>&nbsp; <font style="font-size:9px;color:#64748b;font-family:monospace">Source → Bronze</font><br><br>• Read the landed files straight from the UC volume<br>• spark.read.csv(path, header=True, inferSchema=True)<br>• spark.read.json(path)<br>• No transformation — raw structure preserved' style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#b5651d;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1e293b;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="30" y="352" width="330" height="215" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="n31" value='<b>2. Clean &amp; Standardize</b>&nbsp; <font style="font-size:9px;color:#64748b;font-family:monospace">Bronze → Silver</font><br><br>• Dates: coalesce(to_timestamp) across 5 formats<br>• price: strip "$" and "," → cast double<br>• Categoricals → lower(trim(…))<br>• quantity: null / empty / ≤ 0 → 1, cast int<br>• age: empty or negative → null<br>• dropDuplicates(order_id, product_id)<br>• Drop rows with a null order_id or product_id<br>• ANSI off → bad casts become null, not failures' style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#5b6b7f;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1e293b;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="392" y="352" width="330" height="215" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="n32" value='<b>3. Join &amp; Aggregate</b>&nbsp; <font style="font-size:9px;color:#64748b;font-family:monospace">Silver → Gold</font><br><br>• LEFT JOIN silver_customers on customer_id<br>• Derive order_date, year, month from order_date_ts<br>• groupBy 11 dimensions (product × customer × date)<br>• sum / countDistinct / min / max / avg measures<br>• returned_count and returned_amount via CASE WHEN<br>• Derived KPIs: avg_order_value, avg_price_per_item,<br>• days_since_last_order, refreshed_at' style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#8a6d0b;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1e293b;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="754" y="352" width="330" height="215" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="n33" value='<b>4. Serve</b>&nbsp; <font style="font-size:9px;color:#64748b;font-family:monospace">Gold → Consumption</font><br><br>• Total Sales by Category (donut)<br>• Average Order Value by City (bar)<br>• Global filters: age, category<br>• Ad-hoc SQL across all three layers' style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#1a56c4;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1e293b;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1116" y="352" width="330" height="215" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="n34" value="nb-retail-sales.ipynb · Serverless compute · Unity Catalog: retail_sales_catalog.sales · Delta Lake, overwrite on each run" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;fontColor=#64748b;fontFamily=monospace;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="30" y="591" width="1420" height="38" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.text: Retail Sales Analytics — Medallion Architecture on Databricks
Bronze → Silver → Gold pipeline built in nb-retail-sales.ipynb with PySpark + SQL, governed by Unity Catalog and served through an AI/BI dashboard.
Read the landed files straight from the UC volume
Drop rows with a null order_id or product_id
ANSI off → bad casts become null, not failures
Derive order_date, year, month from order_date_ts
sum / countDistinct / min / max / avg measures
returned_count and returned_amount via CASE WHEN
Ad-hoc SQL across all three layers
nb-retail-sales.ipynb · Serverless compute · Unity Catalog: retail_sales_catalog.sales · Delta Lake, overwrite on each run
